note: 仅导出归属本人的已审阅字段；运行队列、凭据及其他用户资料不纳入导出。

datasets.name: orders
datasets.select: SELECT id,status,total_amount,real_amount,discount_amount,pay_channel,create_time,pay_time,refund_time FROM `order` WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id

datasets.name: items
datasets.select: SELECT id,order_id,course_id,name,price,real_pay_amount,status,refund_status,create_time FROM order_detail WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_detail WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: refunds
datasets.select: SELECT id,order_id,order_detail_id,refund_amount,status,refund_reason,question_desc,create_time,finish_time FROM refund_apply WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refund_apply WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: cart
datasets.select: SELECT id,course_id,course_name,price,create_time FROM cart WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cart WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: operations
datasets.select: SELECT operation_id,kind,status,error_code,created_at,updated_at FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY created_at,operation_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=?
